# Red Prince 1.0.12

## Highlights

- Added optional Bookshop purchase and Library checkout checks.
- Added OP Allowance, which reapplies received Steps, Gems, and Dice each day.
- Added Keep Simple Items Every Run, including first-pickup check completion for restored items.
- Added an electric-blue draft highlight for rooms with unchecked First Entering checks.

## Fixes and logic changes

- Fixed Lost & Found upgrade-disk checks and removed a collected disk so another rare item can spawn.
- Renamed the Gemstone Caverns unlock item to `Unlock Gemstone Caverns`, with compatibility for older seeds in the game plugin.
- Fixed the Blackbridge cutscene override so it skips the day-ending event while retaining cutscene cleanup.
- Moved the Pump Room reservoir crossing to complex logic.
- Restored all 37 requested rooms as configurable locked-trunk check rooms; trunk checks remain off by default.
- Fixed OP Allowance and kept-item restoration to use the authoritative received-item history after reconnecting.

## Compatibility

- Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer.
- The 1.0.12 game plugin and 1.0.12 APWorld should be distributed together.
